items.name: freeCodeCamp

As a nonprofit initiative, it enables free access to coding education with community support. The curriculum is designed for self-paced learning with practical applications.

items.name: react
items.summary: React是一个用于构建用户界面的JavaScript库，特别适用于Web应用程序开发。由Facebook开发，它采用基于组件的开发模式和声明式编程模型。React通过虚拟DOM实现高效的数据变更更新和组件渲染。该库通过React Native支持Web和原生移动端开发，提供跨平台的一致开发体验。
items.summary_en: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces, particularly for web applications. Developed by Facebook, it enables component-based development with a declarative programming model. React efficiently updates and renders components when data changes using its virtual DOM implementation. The library supports both web and native mobile development through React Native, providing a consistent development experience across platforms.

items.name: vue
items.summary: Vue 是一个用于构建用户界面的渐进式 JavaScript 框架。该仓库包含 Vue 2 版本，而 Vue 3 的开发已移至单独的 core 仓库。它提供了专注于视图层的易用核心库，采用可逐步采用的架构。Vue 具有使用模板语法的声明式渲染、基于组件的开发模式和响应式数据绑定等特点。该框架强调简单性和灵活性，适用于 Web 应用程序开发。
items.summary_en: Vue is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. The repository contains Vue 2, while Vue 3 development has moved to a separate core repository. It provides an approachable core library focused on the view layer only, with incrementally adoptable architecture. Vue features declarative rendering using template syntax, component-based development model, and reactive data binding. The framework emphasizes simplicity and flexibility for web application development.

items.name: tensorflow

items.summary_en: TensorFlow is an open-source machine learning framework developed by Google for building and deploying ML models. It provides comprehensive tools for deep learning, neural networks, and various ML algorithms across multiple platforms. The framework supports distributed computing, model training, and deployment in production environments. TensorFlow includes APIs for different programming languages and offers flexibility for research and production use cases in artificial intelligence and data science applications.

items.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations. It provides over 300 plugins for various tools and platforms like Git, Docker, and programming languages, plus 140+ themes for terminal customization. It simplifies shell configuration management and enhances terminal productivity through its extensive plugin ecosystem.

items.name: vscode

items.summary_en: Visual Studio Code is a source code editor developed by Microsoft, built using Electron and TypeScript. It provides debugging support, embedded Git control, syntax highlighting, intelligent code completion, snippets, and code refactoring capabilities. The editor is highly extensible through a rich extension marketplace and supports numerous programming languages. It runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.

items.name: bootstrap
items.summary: Bootstrap 是最流行的开源前端框架，用于开发响应式、移动优先的网页项目。提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 组件，包括排版、表单、按钮、导航等界面元素。框架包含响应式网格系统、预构建组件和强大插件，帮助开发者快速创建一致、现代的网页界面，同时确保跨浏览器兼容性。基于 Sass 构建，支持自定义样式和主题开发。
items.summary_en: Bootstrap is a popular open-source front-end framework for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for typography, forms, buttons, navigation, and other interface elements. Typical use cases include web servers, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, command-line tools, and network applications where concurrency and performance are critical requirements.

items.name: scrcpy
items.summary: scrcpy 是一款开源应用程序，用于通过 USB 或 TCP/IP 在计算机上显示和控制 Android 设备。它实时流式传输设备屏幕，延迟低，并允许通过计算机键盘和鼠标进行完全控制。核心功能包括屏幕镜像、音频转发、设备录制和剪贴板同步。优势在于高性能、无需 root 权限以及跨平台兼容性。典型用例涉及应用程序开发测试、演示、游戏和远程设备管理，无需在 Android 设备上安装额外软件。该项目使用 C 语言开发，依赖 FFmpeg、libav 和 SDL2 库实现高效的多媒体处理。
items.summary_en: scrcpy is an open-source application for displaying and controlling Android devices from a computer via USB or TCP/IP. Core capabilities include screen mirroring, audio forwarding, device recording, and clipboard synchronization. Strengths include high performance, no root requirement, and cross-platform compatibility. Typical use cases involve app development testing, presentations, gaming, and remote device management without installing additional software on the Android device.

items.summary_en: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of system utilities for Windows that enhance productivity and customization. These utilities help users streamline daily tasks and personalize their Windows experience. The open-source project receives regular updates with new features and improvements for Windows 10 and 11.

items.name: electron
items.summary: Electron 是一个使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 等 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用程序的框架。它将 Chromium 渲染引擎与 Node.js 运行时结合，使开发者能够为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 创建类似原生的桌面应用。基于 Electron 构建的应用在基于 Chromium 的窗口中运行，同时可以访问系统级 API。许多流行的桌面应用如 Visual Studio Code 和 Slack 都使用此框架。
items.summary_en: Electron is a framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It combines the Chromium rendering engine with Node.js runtime, enabling developers to create native-like desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Applications built with Electron run in their own Chromium-based window while having access to system-level APIs. Many popular desktop apps like Visual Studio Code and Slack use this framework.

items.summary: Kubernetes是一个开源的容器编排系统，专为自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用而设计。其核心功能包括服务发现、负载均衡、存储编排、自动滚动更新和回滚，以及自我修复能力。主要优势在于生产级别的可靠性、庞大的生态系统和声明式配置模型。典型应用场景包括管理微服务架构、支持持续部署流水线，以及在云环境和本地数据中心运行可扩展的Web应用程序。该项目由CNCF托管，采用Go语言开发，已成为容器编排领域的事实标准。
items.summary_en: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration system designed for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Its core capabilities include service discovery, load balancing, storage orchestration, automated rollouts and rollbacks, and self-healing. Key strengths are its production-grade reliability, extensive ecosystem, and declarative configuration model. Typical use cases include managing microservices architectures, enabling continuous deployment pipelines, and running scalable web applications across cloud and on-premises environments.

items.name: axios
items.summary: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 JavaScript HTTP 客户端库，可在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中运行。其主要目的是通过提供简洁一致的 API 来简化 HTTP 请求处理。核心功能包括发起 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE 等 HTTP 请求、拦截请求和响应、自动 JSON 数据转换以及请求取消功能。关键优势在于基于 Promise 的异步处理、广泛的浏览器兼容性、可配置的默认设置和客户端 XSRF 保护。典型应用场景包括 Web 应用中的 API 数据获取、表单提交处理以及构建 RESTful 服务客户端。该库以其易用性和可靠性成为前端开发中处理网络请求的流行选择。
items.summary_en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client library for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. Its primary purpose is to simplify HTTP requests by providing a clean, consistent API. Core capabilities include making GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests, intercepting requests/responses, automatic JSON data transformation, and request cancellation. Key strengths are its promise-based async handling, wide browser support, configurable defaults, and client-side XSRF protection. Typical use cases involve fetching API data in web applications, handling form submissions, and building RESTful service clients.

items.summary_en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard application designed for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. Its core capabilities include real-time collaboration, vector-based drawing tools, and export functionality. Key strengths are its simplicity, end-to-end encryption for privacy, and being completely free. The platform supports multiple users working simultaneously on diagrams. Typical use cases include technical architecture diagrams, flowcharts, wireframes, brainstorming sessions, and educational illustrations. It runs directly in web browsers without installation requirements.
